description: Record a REQUEST for a custom multi-city itinerary and send it to the Sparkling Tracks team. Use when the customer has picked an option from plan_multi_city_trip or one of the self-paced alternatives and has given their name and email. This does NOT book anything. Returns a reference the traveller can quote.

cities.description: Cities the traveller wants to visit.

month.description: ISO month YYYY-MM. A month that has gone is refused.

notes.description: Anything else the traveller wants us to know.

preferred_option_index.description: Which option they preferred: 0 for the first, 1 for the second, etc.

name: request_custom_itinerary
